text: Nice doctor and staff, friendly and knowledgeable on allergies / lungs. Good place to get tested for allergies.

restaurant_name: ภูมิคลินิกเวชกรรม (Phoom Allergy Clinic)
text: Helpful assessment and explanation in English.

restaurant_name: ภูมิคลินิกเวชกรรม (Phoom Allergy Clinic)
text: Professional and friendly doctor and nurses.

restaurant_name: ภูมิคลินิกเวชกรรม (Phoom Allergy Clinic)
text: I brought my mother to treat her allergy rash. The doctor was very kind, patient, answered all questions, explained everything in detail, and fully outlined the treatment process. They adjusted the appointment schedule/times according to the patient's convenience/needs. The staff/nurses were attentive, polite, and friendly. They responded very quickly to inquiries via LINE. The price might be a bit high, but the treatment is progressing well and showing good results.

restaurant_name: ภูมิคลินิกเวชกรรม (Phoom Allergy Clinic)
text: It's too expensive. The doctor will read you a brochure first, without explaining your symptoms or the cause. They just quoted what the brochure said, and that's all it took to charge 1500++ baht for four oral medications and two small jars of topical cream. If you want the doctor to pinpoint the cause, it will cost several thousand baht. I regret not checking the reviews beforehand. As for the medication's effectiveness, it might be, but I don't know the results yet since I just went. Anyone planning to go to this clinic should bring plenty of money. For me, the price was excessive for just reading a brochure and getting four medications and cream.

restaurant_name: ภูมิคลินิกเวชกรรม (Phoom Allergy Clinic)
text: I had an allergic rash on my face. The doctor explained everything well. I received one injection, was prescribed four oral medications and two tubes of topical cream. The total cost was 2,330 baht. The price is a bit high.

restaurant_name: ภูมิคลินิกเวชกรรม (Phoom Allergy Clinic)
text: Terrible. I called beforehand to ask if it was okay to come in with my condition, and the staff said yes. I arrived 10 minutes later and was told by the staff that the doctor had just left to take a stroke patient out. Would you believe that??

restaurant_name: ภูมิคลินิกเวชกรรม (Phoom Allergy Clinic)
text: The doctor explained the allergies very well, as I'd never had them before. I had a rash all over my arms and legs. After receiving injections, taking medication, and applying ointment, I got better within two days.

restaurant_name: ภูมิคลินิกเวชกรรม (Phoom Allergy Clinic)
text: The cost of the medicine is 2,700+ baht, which is a bit steep. I didn't expect to find such a high cost when I went in for a consultation. The doctor should have informed me beforehand if he was going to prescribe such a high price for medicine. He prescribed so much medicine, but the symptoms weren't that severe. I'd like to ask if he prescribed the medicine as needed. I recommend that anyone who wants to come in ask or find information carefully before coming in for a consultation.

restaurant_name: ภูมิคลินิกเวชกรรม (Phoom Allergy Clinic)
text: 1. Allergy testing revealed a dust allergy. Treatment with allergy shots showed significant improvement. / 2. I had a chronic facial allergy and seborrheic dermatitis for almost two years, and despite treatment at several places, it didn't improve. The medication prescribed by the doctor here showed very quick results. 👍🏻👍🏻 …

restaurant_name: ภูมิคลินิกเวชกรรม (Phoom Allergy Clinic)
text: My first visit for a skin allergy cost 1,800+ baht. That's excessive! I got oral medication, a tube and two jars of ointment for the itchy rash, and a cleansing kit. 1,800+ baht is really outrageous.

restaurant_name: ภูมิคลินิกเวชกรรม (Phoom Allergy Clinic)
text: The doctor is really good at treating allergies. Tests revealed I was allergic to dust mites, and I was treated with a vaccine. My symptoms have been steadily improving. The price is affordable, and the doctor provides excellent care.

text: The doctor is kind and lovely.
